title: Delete is grayed with the saved-lines reason when a tier priced lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with 3 part lines priced by tier A, then invoiced.
  • Have customer A put back on Default after the invoice, so tier A has no customers.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Point at Delete.
  4. Click Archive.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A is listed with Customers 0.

Step 2:

  • Delete is grayed.
  • Audit Log and Archive can be clicked.

Step 3:

  • A tooltip shows beside Delete.
  • It reads tier A's name followed by "priced parts on 3 saved lines, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead." (3 lines on work order 1 = 3).

Step 4:

  • The Archive question for tier A opens.
